tensions: The open disagreement is XTZ. The rulebook says hold — the loss is 10.4%, inside the 15% stop, and the position is two days old, well inside the 14-day window. The discretionary read says it is dead weight with no catalyst and a 2.1% spread, and that $86 in a cash-only account with $13.23 of buying power is worth more as optionality than as Tezos. We defaulted to the rule and flagged the exit as pre-validated but unexecuted. Second tension: Fear & Greed at 69 while the market drops 4.7% is a divergence that usually resolves downward, which argues for raising cash — but raising cash before FOMC is the same as betting on the outcome, and this system does not bet on macro. Sitting still is a position, and today it is the honest one.

SOL +7.1% off the SEC core-ETF-asset designation. Everything else is chop. Watch the calendar, not the candles.
